comment.body: Thanks for the detailed troubleshooting and the useful workaround. This belongs with the open Mouse Without Borders `KeysNotMatched` investigation in #27945 (with closely related setup failures also recorded in #26717). Please consolidate this report there and include the key detail that entering the same value through the UI fails, while writing the identical `SecurityKey` to both `settings.json` files with MWB stopped succeeds. That distinction focuses the existing investigation on settings persistence/reload rather than key generation or network reachability.
